newsitem.title: FRANCE: S&P ups Credit du Nord units ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P ups Credit du Nord units ratings.

text.p: Debt rating agency S&P ADEF said on Friday it was upgrading Credit du Nord SA and three affiliates Banque Rhone-Alpes SA, Banque Tarneaud SA and Banques Kolb SA to long-term AA3 on the ADEF scale from A2.
It is taking the banks off its watch list and said the outlook is stable, S&P ADEF said in a statement.
The banks are being assigned a Standard & Poor's rating on 'A' long-term and A-1 short-term ratings.
Societe Generale will take majority control of Credit du Nord on April 15, S&P said.
